definitions.accuracy: Repetition 1 correct / fixed 24 questions; withheld until complete required collection
definitions.timing: Median over repetitions for each question, then distribution over the fixed 24 question medians
definitions.per_video: Median of that video's three question-level latency medians
definitions.speedup: median(24 reference question medians) / median(24 condition question medians)
definitions.frame_ratio: requested budget / 64; distinct from measured speedup
definitions.relative_timing_range: (max repetition latency - min repetition latency) / median repetition latency
definitions.memory: Maximum observed absolute per-request PyTorch peak including model weights; sampled NVML/RAM labeled separately
definitions.failed_without_success: Attempted trial identities with no valid persisted completed record; never dropped from planned denominator
definitions.sample_size: 24 questions clustered in eight videos; repeated calls are not new examples

setup_costs.definition: Descriptive startup/diagnostic costs; overlapping wall intervals are not summed as a disjoint decomposition
